test_title: All India SSC MTS & Havaldar 2025: Marks Booster Mega Live Test - 04
subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the underlined word.

The advocate was warned for using __casuistry__ to mislead the jury.
solution:
The correct answer is** "certainty".**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Certainty **means the state of being completely sure about something.

 
 
• **Example:** *Death has to come to everyone and this is certain.*
 
 
 
• **Casuistry -** use of clever arguments to trick people.
 
• **Antonym** means words having different meaning from other words.
 
• So, in this question,** 'certainty'** is opposite to** 'casuistry'** that's why an answer is** 'certainty'**. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Sophistry - **the use of clever but false arguments, especially with the intention of deceiving.

 
 
• **Example:*** She knows that it is pure sophistry on his part.*
 
 
 
• **Insinuation - **the action of suggesting, without being direct, that something unpleasant is true.
 
 
• **Example: ***I reject the insinuation behind your question.*
 
 
 
• **Cacophony -** a mixture of loud, unpleasant sounds or noise.
 
 
• **Example:** *I could not think of the cacophony of traffic.*
